Anya: Quick heads-up — we just published the Contributors Starter Templates + Mentorship Pairing pilot for the community repo :tada: 
Anya: Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-starter-templates (v0.9.0-beta) — includes starter projects for: infra, eval harnesses, embedding pipelines, and a tiny demo app.
Anya: TL;DR: make it easy for new contributors to spin up a local dev env, run a smoke eval, and submit a PR with a template-guided workflow.
Anya: Quick commands: `git clone https://github.com/redwood-inference/community-starter-templates && cd infra-template && ./setup.sh` or `npx redwood-init infra-template`
Anya: We also launched a mentorship pairing sheet (volunteer mentors + short-term pairing slots) to help first-time contributors get reviews and guidance. Sign-up: https://forms.gle/mentor-pilot
release-bot: Release created: community-starter-templates v0.9.0-beta — tag: refs/tags/v0.9.0-beta — CI: all checks passed ✅
Devon: Huge win — I'll post an office-hours block for mentor onboarding. Can we do Wed 10am PT recurring for the next 6 weeks?
Anya: Yes please — that works. I'll add an agenda: quick repo tour, how to run templates, review checklist.
Sophie: Adding a short blurb to the community newsletter and the next maintainer update. Want me to include a screenshot or GIF demo?
Anya: GIF would be awesome. Minimal walkthrough: clone -> run setup -> open demo at http://localhost:3000 -> run `npm run smoke-eval`
Mike: Small ask — can we add a default CODEOWNERS entry so reviewers get auto-requested on template PRs?
Anya: Good idea. For now we added `docs/`, `infra/`, `templates/` -> @devon @sophie as CODEOWNERS in the repo. Will iterate.
Pierre: License question: are the templates under Apache-2.0 like other community repos?
Anya: Yes, Apache-2.0. CONTRIBUTING.md updated with contribution license and DCO instructions.
Devon: I'll pin a short checklist in the repo: tests, lint, eval-run, meta:labels (good first issue, mentor-needed).
Sophie: Tagging the marketing queue. Can we set an embargo for public blog until next Tue?
Anya: Yeah let's keep the public blog post until Tue morning, but the release and mentor sign-up are live for maintainers and contributors now.
Mike: Heads-up: I pushed a tiny PR updating the infra template to use the new environment var names — will request review from @devon.
release-bot: CI build 9876 — infra-template — passed in 4m 12s.
Anya: Thanks everyone. If you want to help as a mentor or test a template, drop a note here or sign up on the sheet. :sparkles:
